notice: Generated from isbe/search/capabilities.py and isbe/search/query.py; tests/py/registry/test_search_capabilities.py keeps them equal. The first routing examples use the constraints of the research scope in examples/research/handoff.json (region, languages, publication window) plus a site restriction; the last one is a plan query with region and institution, as a run sends it.

statuses.unsupported: the run cannot ask for it: name it in the query terms or check the results
statuses.unknown: the request may carry it but nothing has checked that the source applies it; never treated as supported

terms.basis: each plan query, normalized by query.compile, is sent as q

phrase.basis: ISBE sends the query text unchanged; whether the instance's engines honour this syntax has not been checked

boolean.basis: ISBE sends the query text unchanged; whether the instance's engines honour this syntax has not been checked

exclusion.basis: ISBE sends the query text unchanged; whether the instance's engines honour this syntax has not been checked

site.basis: ISBE sends the query text unchanged; whether the instance's engines honour this syntax has not been checked

title.basis: ISBE sends the query text unchanged; whether the instance's engines honour this syntax has not been checked

institution.basis: the request has no parameter for it; name it in the query terms or check the results

region.basis: the request has no region parameter; language zh-CN names a language variant, not a place

language.basis: SearXNG passes language to the engines that take one; results are not checked for their language

publication_window.basis: only a recency hint: time_range=month or year when the window starts within 30 or 365 days of the run, otherwise none (providers.time_range); exact dates come from date rechecks

pages.basis: providers.request asks for the first page only

result_count.basis: results.parse keeps the first max_results rows and counts the ones it left out

total_estimate.basis: results.parse reads no total from the response

publication_dates.basis: a date a provider returns is kept as search_date_hint, never as the publication date; date rechecks read the date from the original page
